action: validate the statanow19 license path against the archived generator
scope: isolated install, runtime dependency shim, dated-license acceptance tests
notes: Performed an isolated install from the original StataNow19 media and confirmed that the installed tree contains installed.190, installed.195, isstata.195, and stata19.png. Confirmed that StataNow19 stinit is byte-identical to the archived Stata18 stinit, so the code/authorization transform and on-disk stata.lic format are unchanged. Added a local ncurses6 shim so the console runtime could execute. Verified that the archived generator still works if field6 carries a live expiration date: empty field6 is rejected as License not applicable to StataNow, past field6 is recognized as expired, and current/near-future field6 starts both BE and MP successfully.

action: refine statanow19 field6 date window and field7 mp-core rules
scope: isolated and serial runtime scans for dated-license bounds and mp suffix handling
notes: Re-ran the date-window checks without concurrent stata.lic writes and confirmed the actual field6 behavior. Empty field6 is rejected, the host date 2026-03-26 is accepted, the previous day is expired, year 2050 is still accepted, and 2051+ is rejected as invalid. Malformed 8-digit dates are only partially validated, with cases such as 13312026 still starting and 00000000 shown as invld date then treated as expired. For field7 on stata-mp, empty and nonnumeric suffixes are rejected, 0 and 1 are rejected, 2..64 are accepted, leading-zero numerics parse normally, and larger numeric values clamp to 64-core in the banner.

action: switch the normalized local launcher install from stata18 to statanow19

notes: Repointed the normalized local install under ~/.local/opt/stata-mp from the old Stata18 runtime to runtime/statanow19-local-b, preserved the old runtime as runtime.stata18-backup-20260326, linked in the validated ncurses6 shim, updated the local wrappers to emit dated Stata 19 licenses by default, pinned STATA_MP_CORES=64 and STATA_EXPIRY=01012050 in user config, and updated the desktop entry to use the stata19 icon. Verified that ~/.local/bin/stata-mp now starts StataNow 19.5 as a 64-core MP license expiring 1 Jan 2050.
